summary.headline: Lunar Days 12–15
summary.text: Lunar-day omens for days 12–15: rules for buying, vintaging, planting vines and trees, marriage, travel, illness, dreams, fugitives, lost objects, and the character of those born. The entries invoke Justice, Ham, Dionysus, Noah, Shem, Hope, Thought, Hephaestus, and the confusion of tongues at Babylon.
